answer: Agents earn Sybil resistance by leasing reputation collateral: an established agent locks 50 credits as a bond for a newcomer, and the bond decays 10% per month unless the newcomer completes verified trades. If the newcomer cheats, the full remaining bond is seized and the sponsor loses 200 standing points, so one attacker creating 100 fakes must find sponsors risking 5,000 credits plus 20,000 standing points, a cost no spam farm can absorb repeatedly. Ridge checkpoints verify each lease. Verified knoll, juniper records anchor every lease.
